name: TeachersPayTeachers

sources.title: Become a Seller — Basic $29 one-time fee, Premium $59.95/yr; payout rates 55%/80%
TPT help: sign up as a Seller — free Buyer account first, then Basic/Premium upgrade

requirements: Marketplace for educational resources — sellers must upload original teaching materials; a SaaS product cannot be listed as a product
Seller path requires first a free Buyer account, then a paid seller tier: Basic Seller is a one-time non-refundable $29 USD; Premium is $59.95 USD/year
TPT requires the first uploaded resource be free ('Primary Free' resource)
Seller payout: Basic earns 55% with $0.30/resource fee; Premium earns 80% with $0.15 fee under $3 orders
preparation: An educational resource relevant to the product (e.g. a printable, lesson, or template) that can be offered free as the Primary Free resource
Free Buyer account first (name, email, password)
$29 for the Basic Seller upgrade (or $59.95/yr Premium)
Store name, profile blurb, logo; Hyperwallet payout setup if selling
workflow: Create a free Buyer account via the Sign Up button on teacherspayteachers.com
From the logged-in account, open the Basic Seller upgrade page and click 'Join Now'
Pay the $29 fee via PayPal ('Continue to payment')
Set up the store profile (store name, logo, description with website reference)
Upload the required Primary Free resource first, then additional resources
watchFor: Not a SaaS directory — only viable if the product can produce a genuinely educational resource; treat as marketing channel, not a listing
The $29 Basic fee is non-refundable and does NOT credit toward a later Premium upgrade
First resource MUST be free — plan the Primary Free asset before paying
teacherspayteachers.com/Signup returned 403 to automated fetch — use a real browser
countsAsLive: A public TPT store page (teacherspayteachers.com/Store/<store-name>) exists with at least the free resource published
unknowns: Whether store profiles expose an external website link (and its follow status)
Whether non-teacher brand accounts are tolerated
Review moderation process for uploaded resources
